scenes.text: Etsy just *rewrote the rules* for selling AI stuff

scenes.title: What *changed*
lines: Oct 22: Etsy's new AI rules. Bot-generated listings are banned, and so are untested AI-written guides, patterns and recipes.
Every listing needs one unedited photo of the real item. AI art stays allowed if you shaped it and disclose it.

scenes.title: The *money* use
lines: The flood of lazy AI shops just got cut. If you actually make the thing, you now have less competition.
Prompt Claude: 'Rewrite my 5 listings to pass Etsy's Oct 2026 AI policy: real photo, my creative role stated, no bot filler.'

scenes.title: *Tested*, not hyped
lines: A digital download only passes if it shows a real result: a finished pattern, a tested recipe.
Listings that break the rules can be removed. Source: Etsy Seller Handbook, Oct 22, 2026.

scenes.title: The *cost*
lines: Etsy: 20 cents per listing, 6.5% of each sale, plus 3% and 25 cents processing. No monthly fee.
Claude and ChatGPT free tiers rewrite listings. Canva's Craft image model is free in Dream Lab.

scenes.text: Want our *Etsy-safe AI art* listing checklist? Comment *ETSY* and follow.
